text:
Rio: Sharing a compact timeline mock — main problems: delta bars disappear at small widths and scrub announcements are noisy. figma.com/...

Hannah: Yep, the 6px delta bar becomes a hairline at 10px total height. Also keyboard users lose context when dialog opens; focus isn't restored.

Omar: Proposed fixes: patterned delta for <12px height, increase bar min-height to 8px on hover/focus, and save/restore activeElement around the detail drawer open/close.

Ellie: Accessibility nit: scrubbing updates trigger two announcements because we change aria-label AND aria-pressed on the same chip. Let's centralize to one live region: role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" and update innerText only. Debounce scrubs to 140ms.

a11y-bot: Scan: contrast fail for delta color at compact sizes (2.2:1). Recommendation: patterned fill or border + meet 3:1 for graphical objects. Also ensure dialog has role="dialog" and aria-modal="true".

Rio: Copy tweak: change tooltip microcopy to "Canary preview 1 v4.1.0 1 15% 1 Fix: token expiration" so SR users get immediate context. Also add short offscreen text for paused chips: "preview paused".

Hannah: I'll mock the patterned delta and the focus restore behavior in Figma and add VoiceOver screenshots. Omar please implement announcer + debounce in the frontend branch. We'll ship focus + a11y fixes as a patch and follow-up on the rollback toast next sprint.

Omar: Will do. Setting debounce to 140ms and will only update announcer text with full context.
